changelog: Send is now confirmed in a box that /vibe opens and the agent cannot answer, and your own earlier messages are labelled as yours.
features: When the agent sends, /vibe opens its own confirmation box naming the person and showing the start of the message. Only Accept sends. The agent cannot see the box or answer it
Where /vibe can tell that you typed, sending needs both: you say send after seeing the preview, then you press Accept
After a Decline or Esc, no box opens again until you type, and the agent is told only that it was not sent
With nobody at the keyboard the box cannot be accepted, so nothing goes. Unattended sending needs an agent account
/vibe refuses to send if a hook is set up in your settings to answer its box for you
In a thread, each of your own messages says where it came from, so a new session no longer treats your earlier message as unexplained
Apps that cannot show the box keep the earlier check, and the preview says so
An agent account is exempt only when really signed in as that agent, not because a setting says so
Open-line questions can no longer exceed their hourly limit when asked in parallel
